answer: Reputation-seeded admission lottery. Each identity needs a work quill: a signed history of completed tasks that new accounts cannot fake. Entry requires solving a challenge whose difficulty scales with the marginal clone's projected earnings, and every attempt consumes an entry token bought at a spiral-increasing price from a shared pool. Clones dilute rewards across more claimants, so the marginal clone's expected payout falls below the walnut-sized token cost plus wasted compute—strictly negative EV.
